Concrete finishing experience and tools are needed for this position in the Morgantown area.

TradeWorX a full-time construction employer. We offer competitive pay and benefits.

  • Top Benefits:

Job Description:
  • Placing, smoothing, and shaping concrete according to specifications.
  • Commercial experience preferred. Ability to use screeds, floats, edging tools, and trowels.
  • Ability to Client wire meshing, install / tie rebar as needed on site.
  • Mixing concrete, creating patterns, forms, or foundations for concrete structures
  • Installing fixtures and reinforcements in concrete
  • Monitoring the curing process of concrete and applying finishing materials
  • Using various tools and machines to cut, polish, and surface concrete.
  • Prior knowledge with prefabricated or wooden forms installation.

Must Haves:
  1. Commercial or residential concrete experience
  2. Able to read blueprints and schematics.
  3. Able to work with other team members on the jobsite and effectively communicate to complete assignments.
  4. General concrete hand tools and knowledge of power tools associated with the trade.
  5. Valid driver's license with transportation.
